decision: No qualified, authorized additional OSM access path established. E280 remains closed; do not send new map requests or create an account.

source_docs.observed: Current v2 documentation directs users to sign up for an API key.
Provider landing page describes obtaining an API key through a HeiGIT account.

Migration guide requires an API key with every v2 request and describes a rewritten implementation/new database backend. It lists v2 base https://api.heigit.org/ohsome-api/v2/ and states v1 endpoints will be shut down on 2026-11-30. A scheduled shutdown does not establish present availability.
Features extraction is documented in Parquet format, with spatial area, filter and time parameters. The current reference supports extraction GET and POST; no actual API extraction attempted.

Schema documents osm_id, osm_type, edit_timestamp, major version, minor_version for geometry changes, WKB geometry and other metadata. No actual schema/data validation performed. Contributor/text fields and future valid_to_timestamp would require exclusion in any future projection.
Time parameter supports single historical snapshot timestamps. This is documentation capability, not measured historical source coverage.

Provider attributes OSM contributors and distinguishes post-2012 ODbL history from older CC-BY-SA history. No older history is proposed, downloaded or licensed here; ODbL approval for E280 does not itself approve additional requests.
